summary: Tested Kepala Labor Notification Bell end-to-end: bell + badge + dropdown + mark-all-read + reschedule notification. Backend endpoints (/api/notifications, /api/bookings/public, /api/bookings/{id}/approve, /api/bookings/{id}/reschedule, /api/notifications/read-all) all work. Frontend NotificationBell renders correctly in StaffNav; unread badge, dropdown with RESCHEDULE TU + PENGAJUAN BARU items, mark-read, and outside-click close all verified via Playwright.
passed: Admin can create kepala_labor + tata_usaha users via POST /api/users (schema uses 'name', not 'full_name')
Kalab login returns token + user; initial notifications empty
POST /api/bookings/public creates booking (LAB-2026-0052) and produces a booking_new notification for Kepala Labor within ~2s
POST /api/bookings/{id}/approve by kalab succeeds; booking status=disetujui
POST /api/bookings/{id}/reschedule by TU (with room_id + reason) produces booking_rescheduled notification with old→new schedule text
Frontend: Clicking bell opens [data-testid=notif-dropdown] with 'RESCHEDULE TU' + 'PENGAJUAN BARU' labels, booking code LAB-2026-0052, room, date/time and relative timestamp
Frontend: Clicking outside closes the dropdown

failed.issue: Console warning: 'WebSocket connection to wss://.../api/ws failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is established.' appears on the Kepala Labor dashboard.
failed.evidence: Playwright console logs during login flow show two such warnings; 30s polling still works and notifications appear within ~2s of trigger during test (polling+websocket combo functional).

action_items: Optional: investigate the ws:// handshake being closed early (likely proxy header/upgrade config). Not blocking — polling covers realtime need and the observed latency in tests was acceptable.
notes: POST /api/bookings/public requires nim, nama, kelas, room_id, date, start_time, end_time, purpose, participants, captcha_a, captcha_b, captcha_answer, phone, email.
POST /api/bookings/{id}/reschedule requires room_id, date, start_time, end_time, reason.
